item.title: High Latency bug enables Opus 4 in Agent Mode Chat
item.body:
Type: Bug Hi Team, I think I found a high latency bug in VS Code Copilot Chat. I am on airplane wifi, and I noticed that my VS Code showed no model at all: the model selector was simply missing. Blank space next to where it said Ask (no screenshot). My open chat session was in Ask mode when I switched to VS Code, fwiw. I switched to Agent mode to see if it would refresh the model selector, which it did, but it had Opus 4 selected - even in Agent mode. I gave it a few seconds to see if would switch itself to an Agent-supported model. It didn't. I opened model selector to see if would switch itself to another model - it didn't. So then I fired a quick agent-like request to my chat session to see what would happen. It looks like Opus 4 is trying to operate in Agent mode. Screenshot shows the output.
